scope: one macOS ARM64 selection-only process per implementation; debug profile

input.generator: Header gene_id followed by S0 through S499, then G0 through G49999 each followed by 250 repetitions of tab-separated 0 and 1; all records end in newline.

baseline.description: previous full-matrix parse, stable full variance sort and selected-row clone, reproduced in the probe

stream.description: current materialize_geneset_matrix included directly in the probe

limitations: Single unoptimized local observation; execution order was baseline then stream, with no cold-cache control.
The temporary standalone probe has its own resolved dependencies, recorded in the copied Cargo lock; it is not a packaged RNAA executable.
Matrix generation, downstream adjustment, correlation, Linux and production throughput are excluded.
All genes have equal variance; the test suite separately exercises differing variances, stable ties, numeric values, input validation and cancellation.
The source and manifest contain absolute workspace paths that must be changed to reproduce elsewhere.
